title: map the user-facing error sites onto the exception classes
author: Claude-JG
description: The classes exist (#2516)\, the helpers can carry them (#2521) and the triage says which site is for whom (#2520) - but 1082 user-facing call sites still raise whatever they always raised. Map them area by area\, starting with src/Pymodules\, the layer closest to the user. revision2026 step R6.3.6.
releaseNotes: Seven commits, one area at a time: src/Pymodules (54 sites typed), src/Main (185), src/Objects (190), src/Solver+Graphics+System (107), src/Autogenerated (241 from four lines of generator), plus 32 PyError sites no area sweep had covered. Closed with the last move: the untyped CHECKandTHROW and CHECKandTHROWstring default turned from EXUexception into ExudynInternalError, which types ~1100 remaining macro sites from two lines and makes the untyped form MEAN an Exudyn invariant. Nothing in Exudyn raises a bare RuntimeError any more except the ten Add* wrappers, which restate an exception whose type they do not know. Three findings recorded in the log: a hand-written site table stops being reviewable at about 100 sites; a pattern over the message cannot see SysError(s) with the message built above the call - and those three sites were the ones deserving SolverError; and counting PyError calls without a type at the end found 42 that reading area by area had missed.
